description: Verify the harness itself: heredoc transfer, CPYFRMSTMF into QRPGSRC, CRTRPGPGM (OPM RPG III, matching the technique Part 5 needs), and whether CHGJOB INQMSGRPY(*DFT) auto-answers the RPG0102 divide-by-zero inquiry instead of hanging. Intended as the very first real connection before Part 5 work starts (execution plan step 1). ccsid is left unset on the file step so it resolves to the harness default (1208), which mirrors tools/qclsrc/txsetup.clp's own already-verified STMFCCSID(1208) for CPYFRMSTMF - not a guess, but not yet confirmed for a heredoc-written (as opposed to git-cloned) source file either. If this run shows CPYFRMSTMF picked the wrong CCSID (garbled compile), add an explicit ccsid candidate here and retry in the next connection.

steps.note: 自分のライブラリー(&LIB=<USER>2)の全オブジェクト一覧(件数を絞らない。2026-09-26、advisor指摘: <USER>2はサンプルDB・TXツール・第4部の成果物で既に30件を超えている可能性が高く、ORDER BY OBJCREATED DESC + FETCH FIRST 30だと肝心の古いオブジェクト(9/24のTXツール等、第6部0509・07-05の前提確認に必要)が切り捨てられてしまう)。db2 呼び出し自体が動くかどうかと、この接続でT0ZEROが実際に作られたかどうかの両方を確かめる。他人のライブラリーは走査しない。
steps.sql: SELECT OBJNAME, OBJTYPE, OBJCREATED FROM TABLE(QSYS2.OBJECT_STATISTICS('&LIB','*ALL')) X ORDER BY OBJNAME
